descriptions.preferred: Spring leaves are mid chocolate-brown with light green veining and covered with a soft pubescence. They become an unusual dark olive-green by early summer and then turn bronze-green. Fall color is orange-yellow. The current shoots are covered in a gray bloom. The large leaves have seven to nine deeply incised ovate lobes with tail-like pointed tips. The margins have conspicuous, sharply pointed, hooked teeth. This strong-growing upright cultivar reaches up to 26 ft. (8 m) tall and wide. It was named after a granddaughter of Dutch nurseryman D. M. van Gelderen.

sources.title: 墨特 Acer Shirasawanum 'Mirte'
sources.description: 由荷兰 Firma C. Esveld 苗圃的苗圃主 Cor Van Geldern 在偶然的机会下发现的，以苗圃主女儿的名字 Mirte Yasemin 命名。 和 Acer Shirasawanum 'Yasemin' 叶诗敏一样，属于姐妹品种。 新芽为红色，并有白色绒毛，春叶为巧克力棕红色，并有黄绿色脉纹，叶大且圆，一般为 7-9 叶裂，小叶裂呈胖圆状，锯齿分布均匀，夏季变为橄榄绿色并带有荧光效果，光照及养护状态良好的情况下，夏季会有棕黄色的效果，秋天为黄色或者橘黄色。 生长速度较快，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年株可达 5-6 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A tall, relatively fast-growing, deciduous maple about 6-8m in height, with large, deeply lobed leaves, emerging chocolate brown with light green veining and softly hairy, aging to dark olive then bronze green in summer, turning orange-yellow in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春叶呈中等巧克力褐色，带浅绿色叶脉，表面覆盖柔和茸毛。 至初夏转为少见的深橄榄绿色，随后又变为青铜绿色。 秋色为橙黄色。 当年新梢覆有灰白色蜡粉。 大型叶片具七至九个深裂的卵形裂片，先端呈尾状尖。 叶缘具显著、尖锐且略呈钩状的锯齿。 该品种生长强健、株形直立，高和冠幅均可达 26 英尺（8 米）。 其名称取自荷兰苗圃人 D. M. van Gelderen 的一位孙女。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 高大、长势相对较快的落叶槭树，高约 6-8 米。 叶片大而深裂，初展时呈巧克力褐色，带浅绿色叶脉并覆有柔毛，随后转为深橄榄色，夏季呈古铜绿色，秋季转为橙黄色。
